Location setting: All Other Clinic Types. Operational schedule: Unknown. Daily hours, services, price, insurance, and accessibility fields were not supplied by this intake.
facility.dataCompletenessNotes: Staged import preserved source-backed fields only. Missing hours, prices, services, insurance or coordinates remain unknown.

limitations: HRSA community health centers and CMS hospitals are shown as separate facility types.
A CMS hospital is not counted as primary-care capacity without supporting source evidence.
The loaded facility layer is not a complete provider directory, and missing pins do not mean zero healthcare.
Nearest means shortest straight-line distance among loaded source-backed HRSA community health centers; it does not mean best, highest quality or most appropriate.

Location setting: All Other Clinic Types. Operational schedule: Unknown. Daily hours, services, price, insurance, and accessibility fields were not supplied by this intake.
facility.dataCompletenessNotes: Staged import preserved source-backed fields only. Missing hours, prices, services, insurance or coordinates remain unknown.

limitations: HRSA community health centers and CMS hospitals are shown as separate facility types.
A CMS hospital is not counted as primary-care capacity without supporting source evidence.

Nearest means shortest straight-line distance among loaded source-backed HRSA community health centers; it does not mean best, highest quality or most appropriate.

distanceMethod.note: Straight-line distance from the official Census tract internal point to source-backed facility coordinates. It is not travel distance and does not imply that the nearest loaded center is the best or most appropriate center.

facility.name: Keyport Primary Care Center

source.agency: Health Resources and Services Administration
source.dataset: Health Center Service Delivery and Look-Alike Sites

facility.contactAndSourceNotes: Fields copied from HRSA CSV: site name, address, city, state, postal code, phone, website, HRSA geocoding coordinates, county/FIPS, operating hours per week, site status, and location setting. Location setting: All Other Clinic Types. Operational schedule: Full-Time. Daily hours, services, price, insurance, and accessibility fields were not supplied by this intake.
facility.dataCompletenessNotes: Staged import preserved source-backed fields only. Missing hours, prices, services, insurance or coordinates remain unknown.

limitations: HRSA community health centers and CMS hospitals are shown as separate facility types.
A CMS hospital is not counted as primary-care capacity without supporting source evidence.
The loaded facility layer is not a complete provider directory, and missing pins do not mean zero healthcare.
Nearest means shortest straight-line distance among loaded source-backed HRSA community health centers; it does not mean best, highest quality or most appropriate.

gapDrivers.label: Transportation access
gapDrivers.summary: Transportation conditions can affect whether care is practically reachable. These estimates do not establish why any person did or did not receive care.
gapDrivers.interpretation: Context only. This driver does not create, remove or change the tract's screening state.

gapDrivers.label: Coverage and affordability context
gapDrivers.summary: Insurance and economic conditions can shape access, but tract estimates do not determine an individual's eligibility, coverage or ability to pay.
gapDrivers.interpretation: Context only. This driver does not create, remove or change the tract's screening state.

gapDrivers.label: Ongoing care context
gapDrivers.summary: Modeled chronic-condition and preventive-care estimates describe community context. They are not diagnoses and do not prove a cause of access conditions.
gapDrivers.interpretation: Context only. This driver does not create, remove or change the tract's screening state.

gapDrivers.label: Documented shortage context
gapDrivers.summary: Active HRSA designations document reviewed workforce or underserved-area conditions. Different designation families remain separate.
gapDrivers.interpretation: Context only. This driver does not create, remove or change the tract's screening state.

explanations: 0 of 4 community-health thresholds were met; 2 are required.
The overall CDC/ATSDR SVI rank did not meet the published social-barrier threshold.
No active reviewed HRSA primary-care HPSA or MUA/P designation matched the tract on the checked date.
No current gap flag does not prove adequate access; this rule's elevated-need condition was not met.
limitations: This is a screening flag for public-health planning, not a score, ranking, diagnosis, medical advice or statement about an individual.
CDC PLACES values are modeled tract estimates; SVI is an official percentile rank; HRSA designations can cover a whole tract, part of a tract or a defined population group.
No current gap flag does not prove adequate access. It only means this versioned rule did not meet its published elevated-need condition.
A missing required value always produces Insufficient evidence and is never treated as zero or reassuring evidence.

facility.contactAndSourceNotes: Fields copied from HRSA CSV: site name, address, city, state, postal code, phone, website, HRSA geocoding coordinates, county/FIPS, operating hours per week, site status, and location setting. Location setting: All Other Clinic Types. Operational schedule: Full-Time. Daily hours, services, price, insurance, and accessibility fields were not supplied by this intake.
facility.dataCompletenessNotes: Staged import preserved source-backed fields only. Missing hours, prices, services, insurance or coordinates remain unknown.

limitations: HRSA community health centers and CMS hospitals are shown as separate facility types.
A CMS hospital is not counted as primary-care capacity without supporting source evidence.
The loaded facility layer is not a complete provider directory, and missing pins do not mean zero healthcare.
Nearest means shortest straight-line distance among loaded source-backed HRSA community health centers; it does not mean best, highest quality or most appropriate.

gapDrivers.label: Transportation access

gapDrivers.interpretation: Context only. This driver does not create, remove or change the tract's screening state.

gapDrivers.label: Coverage and affordability context
gapDrivers.summary: Insurance and economic conditions can shape access, but tract estimates do not determine an individual's eligibility, coverage or ability to pay.
gapDrivers.interpretation: Context only. This driver does not create, remove or change the tract's screening state.

gapDrivers.label: Ongoing care context

gapDrivers.interpretation: Context only. This driver does not create, remove or change the tract's screening state.

facility.name: Community Health Center of Asbury Park

source.agency: Health Resources and Services Administration
source.dataset: Health Center Service Delivery and Look-Alike Sites

facility.contactAndSourceNotes: Fields copied from HRSA CSV: site name, address, city, state, postal code, phone, website, HRSA geocoding coordinates, county/FIPS, operating hours per week, site status, and location setting. Location setting: All Other Clinic Types. Operational schedule: Full-Time. Daily hours, services, price, insurance, and accessibility fields were not supplied by this intake.
facility.dataCompletenessNotes: Staged import preserved source-backed fields only. Missing hours, prices, services, insurance or coordinates remain unknown.

limitations: HRSA community health centers and CMS hospitals are shown as separate facility types.
A CMS hospital is not counted as primary-care capacity without supporting source evidence.
The loaded facility layer is not a complete provider directory, and missing pins do not mean zero healthcare.
Nearest means shortest straight-line distance among loaded source-backed HRSA community health centers; it does not mean best, highest quality or most appropriate.

gapDrivers.label: Transportation access

loadedFacilitiesInTract.contactAndSourceNotes: Fields copied from the official CMS Hospital General Information CSV: facility name, address, city, state, ZIP code, county, phone, hospital type, ownership and emergency services flag. Hospital type: Acute Care Hospitals. Ownership: Voluntary non-profit - Private. Emergency services listed by CMS: Yes. Coordinates from the U.S. Census Bureau batch geocoder (Exact address match). CMS quality ratings and measures were intentionally not copied. Daily hours, prices and insurance details were not supplied by this intake.
loadedFacilitiesInTract.dataCompletenessNotes: Staged import preserved source-backed fields only. Missing hours, prices, services, insurance or coordinates remain unknown.

distanceMethod.name: Haversine great-circle distance

limitations: HRSA community health centers and CMS hospitals are shown as separate facility types.

source.agency: Health Resources and Services Administration
source.dataset: Health Center Service Delivery and Look-Alike Sites

facility.contactAndSourceNotes: Fields copied from HRSA CSV: site name, address, city, state, postal code, phone, website, HRSA geocoding coordinates, county/FIPS, operating hours per week, site status, and location setting. Location setting: All Other Clinic Types. Operational schedule: Unknown. Daily hours, services, price, insurance, and accessibility fields were not supplied by this intake.
facility.dataCompletenessNotes: Staged import preserved source-backed fields only. Missing hours, prices, services, insurance or coordinates remain unknown.

limitations: HRSA community health centers and CMS hospitals are shown as separate facility types.
A CMS hospital is not counted as primary-care capacity without supporting source evidence.
The loaded facility layer is not a complete provider directory, and missing pins do not mean zero healthcare.
Nearest means shortest straight-line distance among loaded source-backed HRSA community health centers; it does not mean best, highest quality or most appropriate.

gapDrivers.label: Transportation access
